Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin silk satin molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the lace-trimmed neckline, the small ribbon bow and the liquid sheen against her bare shoulders, fine pull lines and a liquid satin sheen. Pose: standing behind the landmark, weight on one leg with the other leg crossed in front, one hand resting on her outer hip and the other arm hanging relaxed at her side, chin lifted, positioned on the left side of the landmark, standing slightly behind it, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.

Environment: a real famous tourist site photographed at true scale, Sydney Harbour with the Sydney Opera House's white sail-shaped roofs, the harbour bridge and ferries on the blue water placed in the foreground at the centre of the frame, rising only to the height of the women's waists and thighs, tourists and tour buses and cars around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; both women are colossal giants standing one on each side of the landmark, slightly behind it, so that the landmark overlaps only their inner legs and clearly shows how much taller than it they are, their towering heels planted on the harbour promenade, a blue sky with thin clouds behind them, the landmark and both women fully in focus, lit by bright natural daylight with soft shadows.
All: Extreme macro detail on the outfits, the skin and the shadows. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a medium distance with the camera at knee height, the famous landmark large in the foreground at the centre of the frame with one woman standing on each side of it slightly behind it, the whole figure of both women from their feet to the top of their heads completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating their shoes from the ground with the real buildings, cars and trees around their ankles shown at their true size so their colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
